    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):

                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                            grid[ny][nx] != background and (ny, nx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))

    template_cells = {(r, c) for r, c, _ in template}

    r1 = max(r for r, c, _ in template)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, _ in template)
    c1 = max(c for r, c, _ in template)
